metaTitle: Custom Red Embroidered Patches | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom red embroidered patches for uniforms, events, and awards. Bulk pricing available at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Red embroidered patches command attention and convey energy, making them a top choice for safety vests, team uniforms, and recognition awards. Whether you need horizontal ribbon badges for volunteer events or vertical satin ribbons for corporate milestones, the bold red background ensures your logo or message stands out. Our patches are crafted with durable thread and available in multiple sizes to fit your specific application. Decorate with your text or emblem using full-color embroidery for a professional, long-lasting finish that holds up to frequent wear.
heroAltText: Custom red embroidered patches with white text and gold border, suitable for uniforms and awards.
